author: Nica882
quote: Really dissapointed, 13 years they had and they release such a buggy game with such dip in framerate. Why is it now acceptable as gamers that we pay for games that are so buggy. Gameplay is good but it can get a little boring, i feel it's missing an edge. The no disc option is also a disaster and a deliberate attempt to put shops out of business, I'm worried others will follow. I'm shocked it's being give a 99 with so many problems, it does make you ask when you read these reviews and they start with all the issues but still give it a 100. Something fishy is going on.

author: Nica882
quote: Best game ever made, nothing more to say. They just don't make them like this any more, just to show gameplay will always out weight graphics.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)
